question: Select the codes of all warehouses that are above capacity.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "warehouses_info" AS SELECT "location" AS "location", "capacity" AS "capacity", "quoteprefix" AS "quoteprefix", "numberwithquotesuffix" AS "numberwithquotesuffix" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "warehouse_activity" AS SELECT "code" AS "code", "cts" AS "cts", "vl" AS "vl", "wh" AS "wh" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH wi AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS rn, location, CAST(capacity AS DOUBLE) AS capacity
  FROM warehouses_info
), wa AS (
  SELECT code, cts, CAST(vl AS DOUBLE) AS volume, wh
  FROM warehouse_activity
), joined AS (
  SELECT wa.code, wi.location, wi.capacity, wa.volume
  FROM wa
  JOIN wi ON wi.rn = wa.wh
), by_code AS (
  SELECT code, MAX(location) AS location, MAX(capacity) AS capacity, SUM(volume) AS total_volume
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY code
)
SELECT code
FROM by_code
WHERE total_volume > capacity
ORDER BY code ASC
LIMIT 50;
S:
# Produce the codes of warehouses above capacity
# Assumption: warehouse_activity.wh maps to row_number over warehouses_info
sql = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH wi AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS rn, location, CAST(capacity AS DOUBLE) AS capacity
  FROM warehouses_info
), wa AS (
  SELECT code, cts, CAST(vl AS DOUBLE) AS volume, wh
  FROM warehouse_activity
), joined AS (
  SELECT wa.code, wi.location, wi.capacity, wa.volume
  FROM wa
  JOIN wi ON wi.rn = wa.wh
), by_code AS (
  SELECT code, MAX(location) AS location, MAX(capacity) AS capacity, SUM(volume) AS total_volume
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY code
)
SELECT code
FROM by_code
WHERE total_volume > capacity
ORDER BY code ASC
LIMIT 50;
'''
_ = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql)
